summary: Four persons attacked and gang-raped a woman. The accused included a labor supplier and an auto driver. The incident took place in Karimnagar district. Police registered a case and investigated the crime. A special court convicted all four accused and sentenced them to 20 years in prison.
title: Karimnagar court sentences four to 20 years in prison for gang rape
verification_note: The source confirms the conviction of four individuals in a 2017 gang rape case by the Karimnagar SC/ST Special Court.
